examples: Latest nationally published HDT in the official collection is the 2023 measurement, not a 2026 parcel metric
HDT is authority-level rolling-three-year delivery evidence, not site or parcel readiness
Post-adoption housing requirement can cause authority HDT recalculation; old national measurement must not be blindly applied
AMR 2023-24 is monitoring evidence, not an individual planning permission
Local Plan 38864 requirement is strategic plan-level demand
London Riverside completed-home figure is OA-level, not Barking and Dagenham parcel delivery
Barking Riverside 20000-home outline consent is site-level capacity and must be separated from circa-3000 completed homes
Housing delivery evidence cannot promote a parcel without exact geometry and site relation
